g.inkscape:label: Contours (elevation, toggle layer)
g.desc: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada. Elevation: Natural Resources Canada, Canadian Digital Elevation Model. Contours derived from the DEM resampled to a 299 m grid, lightly smoothed, contoured every 200 m and simplified. Overlay for liard_render_v6a.svg: same viewBox, same map-to-poster transform as the river layer.
